# c4-operator

> A Kubernetes operator for the Cinema Content Creation Cloud (C4): content-addressed trees (views) mounted into pods by a CSI driver through node, peer and regional caches, per-project isolation, a deadline-driven work queue for render, CI and ML, a HUD, and an MCP server that gives agents the same controls as people.

Everything a person can do in the HUD an agent can do through the MCP server, as the same user, with the same permissions and the same audit trail. The farm has no priorities: work is ordered by deadlines and estimates.

## For agents

- [MCP tool reference](docs/agents/tools.md): every c4_* tool, its annotations and its input schema, generated from the server
- [c4-farm skill](skills/c4-farm/SKILL.md): how to operate the farm with those tools
- [Evaluation set](docs/agents/eval.xml): questions an agent should answer on the e2e farm after hack/e2e/p5.sh
- [HUD API](internal/hud/API.md): the HTTP contract the HUD and the MCP server share

## Design and evidence

- [DESIGN.md](DESIGN.md): trust model, views and chains, tiers, overlay and CSI, isolation, the work system, the HUD, metering, provenance
- [REPORT-v2.md](REPORT-v2.md): what each phase proved, with numbers
- [e2e results](hack/e2e/out/results.md): measured on an eight-worker kind cluster
- [Scheduling simulation](hack/sim/out/results.md): the work queue's policy against FIFO, EDF and manual priorities

## Operating

- [README.md](README.md): install, the e2e cluster, the commands
- [PROGRESS.md](PROGRESS.md): branches, open questions, proposed changes to the c4 libraries
